confidence_notes: Holistic July estimate. Tourist-oriented meal prices are more predictable; lodging is less certain because Key West has limited hostel supply and strong seasonal variation. Cocktail and wine estimates follow the local price relationship to beer.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Florida Keys and US resort-island pricing: dining and lodging tend to cost more than in typical mainland cities. July is hot and less sought after than winter, though Key West remains a destination market.
